name: Eve Energy (Matter, EU)

radios.note: Eve lists Thread. The CSA listing for 20EBO8301 also shows Bluetooth as a transport, likely for setup, but Eve doesn't confirm it.

matter.note: CSA lists variant SKU 20EBO8301 under Eve Energy certificates (e.g. CSA22065MAT40065-24, firmware 3.1.0). Eve's identify page gives product no. 10EBO8351 for the Matter EU model.

apple_home.note: Through Matter. Normally needs an Apple home hub that is a Thread border router (HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen, Apple TV 4K with Thread).

google_home.note: Through Matter. Needs a Google hub that is a Matter controller and Thread border router.

alexa.note: Through Matter. Needs an Echo that is a Matter controller and Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Through Matter. Needs a SmartThings hub with Thread.

home_assistant.note: Through the Home Assistant Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router on the network.

hubRequired.note: Eve's product page says it needs a Thread + Matter hub, but Eve's iOS 18 post lists the Europe 4th-gen Eve Energy as controllable from an iPhone 15 Pro or later without a hub. Sources disagree.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread runs on the local network, with no Eve account or cloud.

energyMonitoring.note: Built-in power meter. Eve's Matter energy reporting update names Apple Home, Google Home, Home Assistant and SmartThings, not Alexa.

maxLoadWatts.note: Eve's EU Matter quick start guide gives max. 11 A / 2500 W. One Eve support snippet showed 16 A / 3680 W for Europe, which appears to be the Outdoor model's rating.

summary: Eve Energy (EU) works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant, all through Matter over Thread. You need a Thread border router that is also a Matter controller, such as a HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K with Thread, a Nest hub or a Thread-capable Echo. This Schuko version (model 20EBO8301, product no. 10EBO8351) fits Type E and F sockets, is rated 11 A / 2500 W, and has a built-in power meter.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router that is also a Matter controller for most uses.
Rated 11 A / 2500 W, lower than many 16 A Schuko plugs; don't use it for heaters or other high loads above that.
Eve doesn't list Alexa among the controllers that show Matter energy readings.
